Article.ArticleTitle: [A case of left atria subendocardial thrombus with sick sinus syndrome].

Abstract.AbstractText: The clinical data for a patient with sick sinus syndrome was retrospectively analyzed. The patient was treated because of his heart palpitations and the increased chest pain. The patient admitted to the hospital under consideration for the left atrial tumor dependent on the echocardiography findings. After the CT scan and the dynamic ECG examination, the patient successfully underwent the left atrial tumor resection, atrial septal repair and cardiac pacing lead installation. The postoperative pathological diagnosis showed that the infective endocarditis and left atrial thrombus in left atrium was cured. The patient was discharged after postoperative anti-inflammatory therapy. By analyzing the reasons for misdignosis before or during surgery, the possible mechanisms for left atrial subendocardial thrombus have been found. This study suggests that it is necessary to combine imaging diagnosis and clinical observations to distinguish tumor from excrescence.

OtherAbstract.AbstractText: 通过回顾分析1例左心房心内膜下血栓伴病态窦房结综合征的临床资料，提高左心房心内膜下血栓的诊断水平。患者因心悸伴胸痛加重就诊，超声心动图考虑左心房肿瘤而入中南大学湘雅医学院附属海口医院治疗。入院进行CT和动态心电图检查后，行左心房肿瘤切除术、房间隔修补术和心表起搏导线安装术，手术过程顺利。术后病理诊断为感染性心内膜炎并左心房心内膜下血栓，经术后抗炎等治疗后患者治愈出院。 通过分析术前、术中未能准确诊断的原因，建议影像学诊断左心房下血栓应结合临床表现，同时要与肿瘤、赘生物等相鉴别。.
